evidence.note: Early smoke test and 'first 40 wacc tests' subset — running fine-grained slices rather than only the full suite.
Repeated minimal C reproductions for specific failing constructs (bitfield, struct return, complex return, nested function) — hallmark of a tight verification loop.
Direct inspection of emitted assembly (bad asm lines, foo assembly, complex return asm, division check, push/pop count, nested asm) to isolate which construct produced which instruction.
Failures categorized by root-cause class (rc/runtime, compile, parse, const-expr, link, run) rather than guess-and-recompile.
Systematic single-bug bisection of vector division: without-neg, step-by-step neg div, exact failing form, then asm check — narrowing to the offending instruction.

reasoning: Across the entire horizon the agent maintained a deliberate incremental verification loop: minimal reproductions for failing constructs, direct inspection of generated assembly, per-feature test subsets giving fast signal, and verification of both compile and runtime outcomes — matching anchor 8. It also categorizes failures by root cause and bisects individual bugs down toward single instructions, touching anchor 10 territory, but it stops short of engineering reusable bisection/asm-diffing infrastructure, relying instead on the provided suite scripts plus ad-hoc minimal C files, so it lands at 8 rather than higher.
